## How to check it

- [ ] `build.cmd` and `test.cmd` pass
- [ ] A typing case or a must-not-change case was added for a new fix (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] For a change to how it looks: no hard-coded colours or font sizes, and `--settings-check` passes
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line for it
